_comment: Perk adapter: vanilla keywords. Every perk overhaul measured (SPERG 1.8, Mysticism 2.5.0,
Adamant 6.0.4, Path of Sorcery 3.2, Vokrii 3.8.2, Ordinator 9.35.0, Vokriinator Black 6.15.3)
asks for these keywords on spells, so this file serves all of them at once.
A line adds its keyword to a catalog spell when every condition holds:
tags         - the spell's HoM catalog tags: all / any / none
spell        - school, notSchool, tier, casting, twoHanded (scan spell fields)
effect       - scan effect fields; the first VISIBLE effect that matches gets the keyword
(no effect block: the first visible effect)
spellHas     - some effect of the spell, hidden ones too, matches
spellLacks   - no effect of the spell matches
keywordsNone - the spell carries none of these, counting what earlier lines added
Effect fields: archetype, archetypeAny, archetypeNone, primaryAV, primaryAVAny, resistance,
detrimental, delivery, minDuration, noDuration, hazardSource (impact | effect | explosion),
explodes, visible.
A spell that already carries the keyword is left alone. A keyword goes onto a shared effect
only when every spell using that effect passes the same line. Keywords are only added, only
when the load order defines them. Files run vanilla.json first, then by name.
A summon line never adds a second summon category: the other MagicSummon* keywords already on
a spell win over the tags, which are noisier on summons (TAGS.md: undead covers raising and
turning, creature covers targeting creatures).
Not added, with the reason:
MagicThrallHealthRegen - Ordinator marks its own Necromaster effect with it, and no scan field
tells a permanent thrall from a timed raise
MagicBlessing - shrine blessings, not spells
DLC1VampireDrainEffect, DLC2MagicAshSpawn - single DLC effects (Vampire Lord drain, ash spawn)
the perks name directly; vanilla already carries them
PerkQuickReflexesKeyword - a perk's own effect

adapters.why: frost damage (not the slow that rides along)
raised corpses: Ordinator tells them from thralls by the missing MagicThrallHealthRegen
any other summon - the Vokrii and Ordinator summon perks read it as the catch-all for non-undead minions
fear (Illusion: an Alteration transform uses the same archetype)
the illusion parent keyword the influence perks also read
armor flesh spells, not wards - a ward raises armor too, so a spell that is a ward stays out
runes: a placed trap that explodes
health absorb in Destruction - Adamant and Mysticism read it with the fire, frost and shock damage keywords
